_readme: GATE FIXTURE ONLY — not the production config. Points the bridge at THIS repo's own MCP server so g_mcp_pool and h_mcp_server have a server to talk to without depending on anything external. mcp_servers.json must never contain this entry: bridging our own server back into ourselves is a loop (every tool it exposes is already native and gets shadowed).
_inherit_env_why: THE ONE SERVER THAT MAY SEE THE HARNESS ENVIRONMENT, because it IS the harness (2026-08-25). `python -m harness.mcp_server` reads SP_RECALL_REGISTRY, SP_MEMORY_* and the rest to find her stores at all; a scoped child would come up pointed at whatever the defaults resolve to, which is a different store, silently. Spawning our own code in our own tree is not the process boundary bridge.child_env was written for. Every OTHER server gets the start-a-process minimum plus its declared `env` — see harness/mcp_server/bridge.py.
